subject: Hybrid provisioning ETA synchronization for ACME AI
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@cloudpartner.com>, Tomasz Nowak <tomasz.nowak@oemhw.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hybrid provisioning ETA synchronization for ACME AI

Hi Sarah / Tomasz —

Looping you both in to align on timing for the ACME AI dedicated-capacity purchase (DEAL-ACME-1293). The deal team is asking for a clear handoff plan: when OEM cards would be available for our private pools, and what cloud-region-reserved capacity CloudPartner can hold as a short-term bridge if OEM lead times slip.

Key constraints from ACME: production go-live window target is Oct 1, 2027 and they expect predictable per-token unit economics from day one. They prefer a hybrid approach: a short-term reserved capacity commitment in us-west while OEM hardware is fulfilled and provisioned into our dedicated cluster.

What we need from you both by EOD Monday:
- Tomasz: concrete earliest-ship / ETA windows for the quoted config in acme_hw_quote_v3.pdf (include any batch allocation risk and rack-level lead times).
- Sarah: confirmation of the maximum hold / soft-reserve CloudPartner can commit to for us-west region (length of hold, billing cadence, and any ramp constraints).

Attaching the latest ACME HW quote and our internal worksheet with the expected ramp profile. I cc'd Karthik & Marissa for visibility on deployment sequencing and contract timing.

Thanks — short answers are fine, we just want to codify the mutual fallback plan so we can finalize the procurement milestone in the SOW.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Capacity Programs | Redwood Inference
lynx: +1 415 555 0198
From: Tomasz Nowak <tomasz.nowak@oemhw.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 13:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hybrid provisioning ETA synchronization for ACME AI

Dylan / team —

Thanks for the note and the quote. Short version up front: for the exact spec on acme_hw_quote_v3.pdf we can commit to a staged fulfillment model:

1) Initial allocation (priority batch): ships ~8–10 weeks from PO receipt (estimated ship week start: 2027-08-13). Quantity: up to 20 cabinets depending on concurrent orders.
2) Secondary tranche: rolling shipments from 10–18 weeks (bulk fulfillment through Q4).

Risks and caveats:
- Our Q3 production cadence has a region of high demand; until PO is confirmed we only hold soft allocation. To convert soft allocation to hard allocation we require a deposit and a confirmed PO with final SKUs.
- Lead times above assume no long lead electronic components disruption. If there is a silicon or PS supply constraint, pushout could be +4 weeks.
- We can prioritize ACME inventory if deal terms include a short exclusivity window on the first tranche.

Action items I recommend:
- Signed PO + deposit to lock the 8–10 week shipment window.
- Provide expected provisioning dates (net of customs/rack-in) and we’ll convert shipping ETAs into estimated in-rack readiness.

I’ve attached an updated fulfillment note (attachment: oem_fulfillment_notes.txt) and pasted a short sample packing+manifest timeline below for clarity. If you want, we can schedule a 30-min call with our logistics lead next week.

— Tomasz
Tomasz Nowak
OEM Account Lead — EMEA & NA
OEM Hardware Co.
Attachments: oem_fulfillment_notes.txt

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid provisioning ETA synchronization for ACME AI

Dylan —

Happy to confirm what CloudPartner can provide as a short-term bridge. We can offer a soft-reserve pool in us-west with the following parameters:

- Hold duration: up to 12 weeks from LOI, with the option to extend monthly by mutual agreement.
- Minimum commitment: 8 vGPU cabinets equivalent (we map your quoted SKUs to our instance tiers; see cloud_capacity_commitment.xlsx).
- Billing: refundable deposit + monthly usage billing at standard committed-discount rate. If you convert to a longer committed reservation (6+ months), rate improves by another 12%.
- Scale-up cadence: we can ramp 2–4 cabinets per week depending on quota and availability.

Constraints:
- We cannot guarantee work-preserving prefix cache access across a private->cloud routing boundary; there will be some warm-up token cost on day 1 of migration.
- In a forced supply disruption at the OEM, we reserve the right to reallocate held capacity if you don’t submit conversion PO within the 12-week window.

Operational suggestion: include a bridging clause in the SOW: CloudPartner hold + 50% refundable deposit to convert soft allocation to hard reservation. That lets OEM get the PO while Redwood and ACME maintain predictable go-live economics.

Happy to join a call with Tomasz and your ops folks next week to map handoff sequence (ship -> customs -> rack-in -> readiness).

— Sarah
Sarah Liu
Strategic Accounts — CloudPartner Solutions
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid provisioning ETA synchronization for ACME AI

Team —

Thanks all for the quick turn. Summarizing decisions and immediate asks so we can close the procurement milestone in the SOW:

1) OEM (Tomasz): 8–10 week ship for priority batch contingent on PO + deposit. Please send the final deposit amount and invoice template; we’ll get that to ACME legal. (Attachment: acme_hw_quote_v3.pdf)
2) CloudPartner (Sarah): Soft-reserve up to 12 weeks for 8 cabinets in us-west with refundable deposit mechanism. We’ll include the bridging clause in the SOW and share the draft today. (Attachment: cloud_capacity_commitment.xlsx)
3) ACME: confirm acceptance of the hybrid fallback (short-term cloud hold + OEM PO + deposit) and provide a target date for PO submission.

Next steps & owners:
- ACME procurement to confirm PO by 2027-06-25 — owner: ACME procurement
- Redwood (Karthik) to review SOW bridging clause and share internal deployment timeline — owner: Karthik (due 2027-06-21)
- OEM (Tomasz) to send deposit invoice and logistics cadence — owner: Tomasz (due 2027-06-21)
- CloudPartner (Sarah) to provide soft-reserve contract addendum — owner: Sarah (due 2027-06-20)

If anything needs to change in the timing above, flag now — otherwise I’ll paste this summary into the HubSpot deal record and attach the SOW draft.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Head of Capacity Programs | Redwood Inference
